fact: Justice Minister Ziyambi Ziyambi announced in a Government Gazette notice the launch of the Digital Land Administration Platform (DLAP), described as a computerized land administration system for online processing of documents and deeds.

The Herald reports Lands Permanent Secretary Prosper Matondi told Parliament on 8 September 2026 that the National Cadastre System is being developed to integrate land records, mapping and survey databases onto one platform.

Lands Permanent Secretary Prosper Matondi told The Herald the ministry is implementing a land information management system, with the rollout of a digital land management system expected to improve administration within six months.
